tvar.notes:
I built three more modern versions of arm B: B1 squircle, B2 teardrop and B3 flat cover with a soft rim. B0 is today's B, kept for comparison. All three pass the hard rules. The joint wall is at least 2.0 (B0 has 1.585). The gap to the torso is no worse: 3.703 at rest (B1 3.724). The smallest gap over the -45..+135 swing is 1.35 to 1.58, against 1.125 for B0.

The joint sets the top of the arm. The M2b drive hub is a disc of radius 13 around the shoulder axis, and with a 2.0 wall it needs a circle of radius 15 inside the side outline at the seam. So in all three new variants the top of the arm is an arc around the shoulder axis (R about 15.5), instead of B0's flat, squared-off top.
- Design point: this round top lines up with a bigger round black joint cover, if the joint is redesigned wider ("kĺb mi príde úzky").
- Width: it cannot go below about 30.4 at the axis. An early B1 at 29 mm failed (disc rim wall 1.29). Widths are now 30.9 to 31.2 (B0 30.2).
- Thickness: the outer cover is about 0.55 fuller over the joint (6.8 to 6.9 against 6.33 at u 0.22). Max thickness is 16.0 to 16.2 (B0 15.5); that is the cost of the stronger joint wall.

**Inner face and gap**
- In the zone near the torso (u 0.12 to 0.50) the inner face is exactly B's. In B1 it sits 0.03 mm further from the torso; this pays for B1's flatter inner section, which with no offset gave a rest gap of 3.695.
- At the top (u under 0.12) the inner face follows the rounder dome, so the gap improves when the arm is raised. At the hidden stop (+140.5): B0 0.97, new variants 1.32 to 1.47.
- An early run with the inner exponent at 2.4 gave a rest gap of 3.701. So B2 and B3 use B's inner exponent 2.2 over the arm body.

**Seam details**
- B2 has a 0.35 mm reveal: the inner half's edge shows all around the cover. At the bottom that edge belongs to the black tip, so a thin black edge is visible from outside near the bottom (side view). It reads as an accent; if unwanted, use REV only above u 0.75.
- B3's cover overhangs the inner tray by 0.35 mm.
- The locating lip the verifier asked for (centring rim so both halves carry load) is still needed inside, in every variant. It is not part of the outer shape.

**Black tip and magnet posts**
- The black tip keeps the R3 cut-plane normal. B2 uses UTIP 0.82 so its tip is a similar size: tip volume 637 to 688 mm3 (B0 860).
- The cover magnet posts must still sit at u ≥ 0.38 to 0.39 in all variants, same as B (computed with post_move_b.py). The disc reaches down to about u 0.40.

**Smaller numbers**
- Width over both arms: B1 143.6, B2 143.2, B3 144.8 (B0 144.4).
- The smallest section rounding radius is 1.9 mm, bigger than the 1.2 wall, so shells can be offset inward without trouble.

**Dropped**
- B4 "oblý kameň" (soft pebble) is still in VARIANTS but not in VIDS. It was only a rounder B0, and its round top is now in all three.

**Module and checks**
- variants_b.py imports placement, swing and frames from the R3 module unchanged. It adds half_widths(vid, u) and reveal(vid) to the R3 API (+ means the cover is inset, − means the cover overhangs).
- B0 delegates to R3 'B', and an assert checks it at import. Section deviation is 0.0; inside, rows and half_rows are identical; the bump2 family reproduces B's profiles to 4e-15.
- Fit numbers come from R3/mech/fit.py, option M2b, run through R4/tvar/fitall.sh (out/fit_<v>.json). Every part and stop passes. The lowest outer margin over the 1.5 requirement is 0.61 to 0.70.
- Gaps come from R4/tvar/chk_b.py, a copy of chk_variants.py with the same rec1 method. Results are in out/chk_B0.json and out/chk_B1_B2_B3_B4.json.
- All numbers are in /tmp/claude-0/gapwf/fin/R4/tvar/out/nums_b.json (made by nums_b.py).

**Render pipeline** (all in /tmp/claude-0/gapwf/fin/R4/img)
- scene_v4.py is a copy of scene_v3.py that imports variants_b. It adds a shot `armlook` (arm alone; views bok, spredu, tri, zhora, vnutro). The front, heroarm, armfront and zoom shots work unchanged with --vids B0,B1,B2,B3.
- Sheets: sheet_b.py (main preview sheet, Slovak) and plotprof2.py (line-drawing comparison against B0 with the disc and its 2 mm wall circle); contact.py makes quick contact sheets.
- Previews are 500 px with 16 samples (preview quality). The black joint ring in them is still the v2 plug. No files outside R4 were edited.

variants.idea_sk: Medzi trupom a rukou je vidieť len tenký čierny krúžok D13 zo zátky (3,7 mm medzera). Referencia, nič sa nemení.
variants.arm_gap_change: Bez zmeny: biela medzera ruka–trup je 3,70 v pokoji, najmenej 1,12 pri −45…+135° (pri 135°) a 0,97 pri skrytom doraze +140,5°. Krúžok D13 prechádza otvorom D14 v ruke s radiálnou vôľou 0,50 (je to tak navrhnuté).
variants.parts_changed: nič (referencia); STL pôvodnej zátky prerobené z receptu v2 kvôli porovnaniu: stl/K0/PLG_zatka_K0.stl, PLG_skrutky.stl, A_vnut_otvor_K0.stl (otvor D14)
variants.mechanical_consequences: Žiadne. Na pohľade spredu je čierny pás 12,8 mm vysoký (z −23,4…−10,6); viditeľná dĺžka krúžku 4,2 hore / 4,7 vpredu / 4,2 dole / 5,4 vzadu.

variants.idea_sk: Čierny golier D22 je súčasťou ruky (točí sa s ňou) a zasúva sa do plochého vybrania v zátke, takže od trupu do ruky ide hrubý čierny krk. Koniec golieru má mäkké zaoblenie R1,5 (ako pneumatika na R01).
variants.arm_gap_change: Biela medzera ruka–trup sa nemení (3,70 / 1,12 / 0,97). Golier je 0,90 od dna aj steny vybrania v zátke a 3,0 od jamky v T_bok_L, a to v každej polohe ruky (je rotačne súmerný). Skryté vnútri: vŕtanie golieru je 0,40 od hrdla krúžku zátky (klzná vôľa, platí pravidlo ≥0,3) a 0,97 od skrutiek zátky.
variants.parts_changed: Zátka sa dotlačí: ploché medzikružné vybranie r 7,2–11,9 s dnom na x 45,4; skrutky pri 4 a 8 hodinách sú zapustené na 45,4. Vnútorná polovica ruky A_vnut: otvor D14 → D22,2. Náboj ruky (ARM_naboj + doraz M2b) sa tlačí z čiernej živice spolu s golierom D22 ako jeden diel ARM_naboj_golier_K1 a lepí sa do A_vnut. Súbory STL: PLG_zatka_K1, PLG_skrutky, ARM_golier_K1 (viditeľný diel), ARM_naboj_golier_K1 (diel na tlač), A_vnut_otvor_K1.
variants.mechanical_consequences: Náboj sa stáva samostatným čiernym dielom: je tuhší, lebo namiesto steny 1,2 má rúru r 7,6–11. V jeho koreni pri trupe je miesto na ložisko 6700ZZ (OD 15), ktoré je na sklade; MR128 by potom nebolo treba (overí sa pri prerobení kĺbu). Pribudne jeden lepený spoj náboj–A_vnut; prenáša len malý moment spojky. Dno vybrania v zátke je 1,4 nad vnútornou dutinou (≥1,2 OK). Ruka sa nasadzuje osovo ako dnes, golier sa zasunie do vybrania. Vonkajší kryt A_vonk sa skladá bez zmeny, káble nie sú. Vôľa k M2b: doraz zátky 0,91, ostatné ≥1,1; zmestenie M2b sa nemení. Čierny pás spredu má výšku 21,7 mm (dnes 12,8). Viditeľná dĺžka golieru je 2,4 hore, 6,1 vpredu, 3,1 dole a 5,9 vzadu. Hore zostáva medzi golierom a zapustenou zátkou čierna škára asi 2,5 mm.

variants.name_sk: K2 – kryt kĺbu D26 v trupe
variants.idea_sk: Zátka vyrastie z jamky trupu ako pevný čierny valec D26,4 (ako kryt 04 na R08). Má hranu R0,7 a čelné vybranie D21,6. Ruka sa nemení, v medzere ostáva tenký krúžok D13.
variants.arm_gap_change: Biela medzera ruka–biely trup sa nemení (3,70 / 1,12 / 0,97). NOVÉ: ruka je od pevného čierneho krytu 1,29 v každej polohe, keďže kryt je rotačne súmerný. Najbližšie miesto je horná vnútorná plocha ruky (r 10,9 nad osou). V pokoji je teda ruka od 'trupu' (krytu) 1,29 namiesto 3,70; pravidlo ≥1,0 platí.
variants.parts_changed: Mení sa len zátka (dotlač). Telo zátky D26,4 (o 0,8 menšie ako jamka D28) vyrastie z jamky po x 47,4 s hranou R0,7, má čelné vybranie D21,6 hlboké 1,0 a 3 otvory D4,6 k zapusteným skrutkám zátky. Starý šikmý čelný povrch zátky nad x 44,5 je odrezaný. Ruka ani A_vnut sa nemenia. Súbory STL: PLG_zatka_K2, PLG_skrutky.
variants.mechanical_consequences: Najlacnejšia zmena: nový je len jeden tlačený diel a mechanika ruky ostáva. Kryt je pevný a s rukou sa nedotýka (1,29). Ku skrutkám zátky sa ide cez otvory D4,6 v čele krytu; zo šikmého pohľadu ich v medzere vidno (čierne skrutky alebo krytky). Okolo krytu v jamke je škára 0,8 namiesto 0,5. Hore kryt vyčnieva z trupu 5,3, vzadu 4,1, vpredu 1,8; dole je skrytý v jamke, takže spodná polovica kĺbu zostáva úzka (krúžok D13). Čierny pás spredu má výšku 19,4 mm. Najlepšie vyzerá šikmo zozadu a zhora, kde je vidieť lesklý čierny valec.

variants.idea_sk: Pevný kryt D26,4 z trupu (ako K2) a čierny prstenec D26,2 na ruke. Medzi nimi je škára 0,9 s labyrintom, ktorý ju zvnútra zakryje. Spolu pôsobia ako jeden veľký čierny valec medzi trupom a rukou (R01, R08 04+05).
variants.arm_gap_change: Biela medzera ruka–trup sa nemení (3,70 / 1,12 / 0,97). Čierne vôle platia v každej polohe: prstenec–kryt 0,89 (škára + labyrint), prstenec–stena jamky T_bok_L 0,90, prstenec–skrutky zátky 0,88. Biela ruka je od krytu mimo prstenca 2,16. Skryté vnútri: prstenec–krúžok zátky 0,50 a čierny náboj–doraz zátky 0,30 (= pravidlo).
variants.parts_changed: Zátka je rovnaká ako v K2. Vnútorná polovica ruky A_vnut: otvor D14 → D26,4. Náboj ruky + doraz + prstenec D26,2 (koniec x 48,3, R0,6, nákružok r 7–10 siaha 1,0 dopredu do vybrania krytu) = jeden čierny tlačený diel ARM_naboj_prstenec_K3, ktorý sa lepí do A_vnut. Súbory STL: PLG_zatka_K3, PLG_skrutky, ARM_prstenec_K3 (viditeľný), ARM_naboj_prstenec_K3 (na tlač), A_vnut_otvor_K3.
variants.mechanical_consequences: Náboj s prstencom je hrubý čierny diel (r 7–13,1, dĺžka 8,6), oveľa tuhší ako dnešná stena náboja. Do prstenca pri trupe sa zmestí 6700ZZ (vŕtanie D15, stena 5,6), ktoré je na sklade: ložisko by bolo bližšie k trupu a MR128 by nebolo treba; overí sa pri prerobení kĺbu. Labyrint zakrýva škáru a krúžok D13 a drží von prach. Skrutky zátky sú schované pod prstencom. Ruka sa nasadzuje osovo ako dnes: nákružok vojde do vybrania krytu. Kryt A_vonk sa skladá bez zmeny. Pribudne jeden lepený spoj náboj–A_vnut (radšej s 3 vodiacimi rebrami). Vôle 0,88–0,90 vyžadujú presnosť tlače čela ±0,1. Vôľa k M2b: krúžok zátky 0,5, podložka M12 0,5, unášač 2,8; rezerva M2b na vonkajší kryt (0,085) sa nemení. Čierny pás spredu má výšku 26,0 mm a plochu asi 2,6× väčšiu ako dnes. Čierna dĺžka je 7,4 hore, 8,7 vpredu, 3,7 dole a 10,8 vzadu. Odporúčaný variant.

variants.name_sk: K3v – ako K3, ruka o 1,5 mm ďalej
variants.idea_sk: Ako K3, ale ruka je o 1,5 mm ďalej od trupu: kĺb je o 1,5 mm dlhší a výraznejší, robot je o 3 mm širší.
variants.arm_gap_change: Biela medzera ruka–trup sa zväčší o 1,5: 5,16 v pokoji, 2,47 pri 135° a 2,31 pri +140,5°. Čierne vôle: prstenec–kryt 0,89, prstenec–jamka 1,28, ruka–kryt 2,16.
variants.parts_changed: Ako K3, plus ruka sa posunie z dx −1,0 na +0,5. Krúžok a sedlo zátky sa predĺžia o 1,5 a kryt končí na x 48,9. Celý balík M2b na strane ruky (náboj, MR128, podložka, unášač, magnety) sa posunie o +1,5. Skrutka pohonu M4×20 sa zmení na dlhšiu: DIN 7984 M4×22 sa bežne nepredáva, takže M4×25 alebo podložka. Súbory STL: PLG_zatka_K3v, ARM_prstenec_K3v, ARM_naboj_prstenec_K3v, A_vnut_otvor_K3v.
variants.mechanical_consequences: Robot je 147,4 široký namiesto 144,4, teda o 1,4 širší ako podstavec 146; ruky sú opäť najširšie miesto. Krúžok zátky je konzola o 1,5 dlhšia, čo dáva asi +10 % ohybového momentu pri koreni od váhy ruky. Treba dlhšiu skrutku pohonu (overiť záber v unášači a kolese). Čierna dĺžka je 8,9 hore, 10,2 vpredu, 5,2 dole a 12,3 vzadu; čierna plocha spredu je asi 3,2× väčšia ako dnes. Ruka pôsobí menej 'prilepená' k trupu. Je to voliteľný doplnok ku K3, ak by K3 bolo stále málo.

klb.notes:
Recommendation: K3. It reads like R01/R08: one black D26 cylinder with a fine seam between the torso and the arm. The arm does not move, the white arm–torso gap stays exactly as today (3.70 at rest / 1.12 at 135° / 0.97 at +140.5°), and every black clearance is at least 0.88. K3v is the "even chunkier" option and costs 3 mm of robot width. K1 is the medium option. K2 is the cheapest (only the plug is reprinted) but the lower half of the joint stays narrow.

How I iterated:
- v1 was a D27 cover + D25 ring. The 1 mm step and a see-through 0.9 seam made the joint look like two separate pieces, and the D13 ring showed through the seam.
- v2 (final) uses a cover D26.4 + ring D26.2, so they are practically flush. The ring has a spigot r 7–10 that fills the seam (labyrinth), so the seam now reads as a dark line.
- The old sloped plug face is trimmed above x 44.5. Otherwise it stuck out past the cover end at the bottom of the socket and came within 0.3 of the ring.
- The socket hole in T_bok_L was measured as r 14.0, not 13.75. That sets the ring to r ≤ 13.2 (0.8 to the socket wall).

Key geometry facts (arm B):
- The torso surface around the socket is strongly sloped: rim x 42.1 at the top, 45.6 at the front, 49.2 at the bottom.
- The arm's inner face is closest above the axis (x 48.52 at r 8–9). This is why a static cover cannot end beyond about x 47.7, and why the cover shows 5.3 mm at the top but is buried at the bottom.
- All new joint parts are solids of revolution about the swing axis, so their clearances are pose-independent. They are exact 2-D (x, r) profile distances against the meshes.
- The arm sweep (−51…142°, refined) reproduces R3 for the white gap exactly (3.703 / 1.124 / 0.969).

Files in /tmp/claude-0/gapwf/fin/R4/klb:
- klb.py (importable in both venvs): VARIANTS, variant(vid) → parts with id / name_sk / role (static | rotating) / mat (cierna, ocel_cierna) / stl (+ print_stl for the black hub+ring part) / replaces; hide = ['zatka', 'zatka_skrutky']; arm_dx(vid); swing_matrix(deg); mirror_matrix(M); profiles.
- Rotating parts get the same world matrix as the arm. The right side is mirror_copy.
- scene_klb.py shows the exact loading: it execs scene_v3.py without its dispatch, loads the variant parts, and adds a dark filler in the collar/ring bore, because the closed arm render solid would otherwise show white there.
- build_klb.py (build123d) writes stl/<vid>/*.stl and step/<vid>/*.step. All solids are valid; the printable hub parts are one solid each. exp_avnut.py (Blender) writes A_vnut_otvor_<vid>.stl, the inner half shell with the new opening (0 non-manifold edges).
- chk_klb.py → chk_klb.json; chk_merged.json (printed hub part vs M2b); nums_klb.py → klb_summary.json (all numbers for the sheets, including the front-view band from the renders).
- sec_klb.py → prev500/rez_*.png (check sections at y = 3). sheet_klb.py → prev500/nahlad_klb.png (preview sheet in Slovak).
- prev500/<shot>_<vid>.png are single renders at 500 px / 16 samples. Shots: front, frontw, p34f, p34fr, p34b, p34br, hero; each has a *_cam.json.

Camera advice for the image agent:
- The joint reads best in the front ortho close-up, the frontal 3/4 (dv 0.42,−1,0.26, R01-like) and the back 3/4 (dv 0.85,0.95,0.40), with the arm hanging and raised 90°.
- The R3 hero direction (0.95,−0.80,0.30) hides the joint behind the arm; all variants look nearly the same there.
- The small cyan dot under the joint in the back views is the head's LED ring reflected in the glossy black plug, not a part.

Limits and honesty:
- The joint internals stay the M2b envelope. The printed hub parts are merged with the M2b ARM_naboj + ARM_rebro, so they will be redone when the joint is redesigned around 6700ZZ. K1/K3 have room for a 6700ZZ inside the collar/ring near the torso, but that is not verified.
- The plug is rebuilt from the v2 zatka recipe (seat r 5 to 57.5). Its hidden internals differ slightly from M2b's PLG_cap; the visible exterior is identical.
- The front-view black-band numbers come from the renders. Their absolute widths include about 1–2 mm of edge shading; heights and ratios are reliable.
- The K3/K3v sweep value 1.43 to the plug is a conservative lower bound from the closed-arm model; the exact pose-independent arm–cover value is 2.16.
- The cover-to-arm gap in K2 (1.29) is a real change at rest versus 3.70 today (to a black static part). That is stated in arm_gap_change.
- I did not edit any file outside /tmp/claude-0/gapwf/fin/R4.

The three sheets are finished (1400 px wide, 48 samples, 3 threads), all text in Slovak with diacritics. I recommend B1 + K3. I checked that combination only with my own pre-check, not with an independent verification.

**Pipeline** (everything is in /tmp/claude-0/gapwf/fin/R4/img/work; nothing outside R4 was edited):
- `scene_v3_r4.py` is a copy of R3 `scene_v3.py`. Only three things changed: the shape module is now R4/tvar/variants_b.py, it uses `parse_known_args`, and the default vids are B0..B3. Materials, lights and cameras are the v3 ones.
- `scene_r4.py` runs that copy without its dispatch. Shots:
  - `front`: `--base 0` is the upper robot, `--tag` names the output.
  - `hero`: the v3 hero camera.
  - `armlook`: the arm alone, seen from outside, front and top.
  - `kfront`, `kp34`, `kp34r`: shoulder close-ups for any arm.
  - `r01`: a new view like R01, front-left.
- Joint parts are loaded on both sides (right side = mirror). Rotating parts get the arm's swing matrix; I checked that it equals g2.V.swing_matrix.
- `render_final.sh` makes the sheet 1 and 2 renders and `render_combo.sh` the sheet 3 renders; all go to `r/`.
- `nums_r4.py` collects the numbers from the verifiers' and designers' JSONs, asserts them and writes `nums_r4.json`. `combo_chk.py` writes `combo_chk.json`.
- `sheets_r4.py` (plus `sheet3_r4.py`) builds the sheets: `/opt/venv/cad/bin/python sheets_r4.py r ../final [zaoblenia klb odporucanie]`. Called with no names it builds sheets 1 and 2; `odporucanie` must be named.

**Decisions:**
- Sheet 1 uses the original v2 plug, the same as the v3 sheets. Its row 1 has no base, cropped at the base top (z −86.2), because the task asked for the upper robot.
- Sheet 2 uses the klb.py parts for all four variants, including PLG_zatka_K0.
